children: Phreesia posted second-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $129.5 million and adjusted EBITDA of $32.9 million, reflecting year‑over‑year improvement in profitability. The company generated net income of $1.9 million and $13.8 million of free cash flow for the quarter while reducing debt principal by more than $23 million. Management reiterated FY2027 guidance for revenue of $510–$520 million and adjusted EBITDA of $125–$135 million, and noted ongoing investments in AccessOne, ProviderConnect and AI capabilities.
Total revenue: $129.5 million for the quarter, up 10% year‑over‑year.
Adjusted EBITDA: $32.9 million for the quarter (non‑GAAP).
Net income: $1.9 million for the quarter (compared with $0.7 million in the prior-year period).
Free cash flow: $13.8 million for the quarter (net cash provided by operating activities of $18.3 million less capital expenditures and capitalized software).
Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash: $74.6 million as of July 31, 2026; outstanding borrowings under credit facility: $61.0 million as of July 31, 2026.
Average number of healthcare services clients (AHSCs): 4,744 in the quarter, up 6% year‑over‑year.
Total revenue per AHSC: $27,289 for the quarter, up 4% year‑over‑year.

Segment performance: Subscription and related services, payment solutions and network solutions all contributed to total revenue; payment solutions and network solutions together represented a substantial portion of revenue.
Strategic initiatives: Continued rollout and expected contribution from AccessOne and ProviderConnect, and expanded application of AI across products and operations.

Restructuring: Implemented a cost‑alignment plan in May 2026 to reduce operating expenses, including elimination of ~220 positions; recognized approximately $2.8 million of restructuring charges in Q2 and expect total restructuring charges of ~$10 million, with substantial completion during fiscal 2027.
